summary.text: Maureen McCarville is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 42 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her current term as beginning on January 6, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Maureen McCarville served in the Wisconsin National Guard for a decade, according to Ballotpedia, and her career experience includes working in business.
McCarville was assigned to the Energy and Utilities Committee and the Veterans and Military Affairs Committee for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
